\[
E = \{\, p : v(p) \ge T_L \text{ and a path of pixels with } v \ge T_L \text{ joins } p \text{ to a pixel with } v \ge T_H \,\}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(v(p)\): The input value at p
- \(T_L\): The low threshold
- \(T_H\): The high threshold

v is the input value, T_L the low threshold and T_H the high one. Each step of the path goes to one of the 4 or 8 neighbors. Pixels in E become 255 and all others 0. The tests use greater than or equal, as in Gonzalez and Woods. scikit-image uses greater than, which gives the same result on whole numbers with thresholds lowered by one half.
